welcome.exploring.body: Welcome to AOEhub! Whether you're curious about education or simply interested in discovering different ways of learning, there's plenty here to explore. Check out the Philosophy tag on the AOE Experience Board to learn about different educational ideas, or start with the File Board's beginner picks to see how those ideas can be put into practice.
welcome.inSchool.body: Welcome to AOEhub! Whether you're looking for extra learning resources, different educational ideas, or simply something interesting to explore alongside school, there's plenty here to discover. You can explore the Philosophy tag on the AOE Experience Board to learn about the ideas shared here, or browse the File Board for learning materials.
welcome.homeschooling.body: Welcome to AOEhub! Whether you homeschool or unschool, this is a place to share experiences, exchange ideas, and see how other families approach learning. You can share what's working (or what isn't) on the AOE Experience Board, or explore the File Board for curricula and resources shared by others.

staff.rules.title: Rules for reviewers
staff.rules.r1: Every action needs a reason from the fixed list: delete, warn, dismiss and notice. No reason, no action.
staff.rules.r2: The reason sets the warning level. You cannot pick or change the level.
staff.rules.r3: Counts, restrictions and reports follow the fixed thresholds and cannot be skipped or forced.
staff.rules.r4: Only the Creator deletes accounts, undoes warnings, or changes a notice the Creator added.
staff.rules.r5: No self-review: you cannot act on your own posts, comments or files. Another reviewer will.
staff.rules.r6: Everything you do is recorded with your name and the time, and kept as evidence. Misuse can cost you the role.
staff.rules.r7: Deleting is not final for 30 days: the Creator can restore anything during that time.
staff.watcherIntro: You can see every post, comment and file, and every report. Add a notice, warn, delete, or dismiss.
staff.deaconIntro: You can see every post and comment, and the reports on them (never files). Add a notice, warn, delete, or dismiss.
staff.reviewOnly: This panel is for reviewing only. You can't post, upload files, or list items for sale from here. To do those, leave the panel and use the hub as yourself, like any other member.

cookie.body: AOEhub only uses the small cookies and browser storage it needs to work: to keep you signed in and to remember your language, theme and text size. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Privacy Policy
landing.subhead2: Whether you homeschool, unschool, attend school, teach, or simply enjoy learning, discover different perspectives and new ways to explore the world.
landing.browse: Or simply explore the AOE Experience Board and File Board — no account needed to browse.
landing.freeTitle: Free to Explore. Free to Share.
landing.freeDesc:
The AOE Experience Board and File Board are free to join and use. Browse without an account, or sign up to download, post, and join discussions.

A marketplace for buying and selling educational materials may be added in the future.
landing.pullquote: “Education is an atmosphere, a discipline, and a life.”

landing.buzzDesc:
Homeschooling and unschooling rules differ from place to place, and they change. The Buzzora Board follows the big developments around the world: new laws, court rulings, government proposals and funding programs, gathered from government sites and major news outlets.

Every post links to its sources and says plainly what is only a proposal and what is already in force. Browse by News, Law or Regulation, or filter by country. Summaries are collected by AI, so always check the source. This is information, not legal advice.
